# Issue #47: flag parsing treats "off " as true

A setting written as `off ` with a trailing space ends up enabled. This showed up
when reading feature switches from the environment. Please fix the flag parsing.

arguments.summary: Fixed issue #47 in flags/parse.py: parse_flag lowercased the input but never stripped whitespace, so "off " (trailing space) didn't match the false-words set and was treated as True. Changed `word = text.lower()` to `word = text.strip().lower()`, which also makes the empty/whitespace-only ValueError check correct. Verified "off " now parses to False, "  off" to False, "on " to True, and the existing test suite passes.
